title: Notice regarding Special Courts on 16.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 15/10/2026
It is hereby notified that on 16/10/2026;
as per the Notification dated 22.09.2026.

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 15/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-01/2026
It is hereby notified that on 16/10/2026;
1. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble the Acting Chief Justice Mr. Justice Manash
Ranjan Pathak and Hon’ble Mr. Justice D. N. Ray would sit in
Special Division Bench and take up the notified matter/s.
2. After completion of matters at Sr. No.1 above, Hon’ble the Acting
Chief Justice Mr. Justice Manash Ranjan Pathak would sit Single
and take up the matters as per Roster.
3. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice A.S.Supehia and Hon’ble Ms.
Justice Gita Gopi would sit in Special Division Bench and take up
the notified matter/s.
4. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 3 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
A.S.Supehia and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Pranav Trivedi would sit in
Special Division Bench and take up the notified matter/s.
5. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K. Vishen and Hon’ble
Ms. Justice Nisha M. Thakore would sit in Special Division Bench
and take up the notified matter/s.
6. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 5 above, Hon’ble Ms. Justice
Sangeeta K. Vishen would sit Single and take up the notified
matters.
7. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice Ilesh J. Vora would sit Single and
take up the notified matters.
8. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 7 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Ilesh J. Vora and Hon’ble Mr. Justice R.T.Vachhani would sit in
Regular Division Bench and take up the matters as per Roster.
9. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 3 above, Hon’ble Ms. Justice
Gita Gopi and Hon’ble Ms. Justice S. V. Pinto would sit in Special
Division Bench and take up the notified matter/s.
10. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 9 above, Hon’ble Ms. Justice
Gita Gopi would sit Single and take up the notified matters.
11. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 10 above, Hon’ble Ms.
Justice Gita Gopi and Hon’ble Mr. Justice L. S. Pirzada would sit in
Regular Division Bench and take up the matters as per Roster.
12. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Ms. Justice Vaibhavi D. Nanavati would sit
Single and take up the notified matters.
13. At 03:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice Nirzar S. Desai would sit Single
and take up the notified matters.
14. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice Nikhil S. Kariel would sit Single and
take up the notified matters.
15. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 4 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Pranav Trivedi would sit Single and take up the matters as per
Roster.
16. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 1 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
D. N. Ray would take up the specially assigned Arbitration matters
as per the Notification dated 22.09.2026.
17. After the work of Division Bench is over, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
J. L. Odedra would sit Single and take up the notified matters.
By Order
Sd/-
Registrar Judicial
